title: The Salt Current
author: Isandro Villalobos
blurb: Ada Ashgrove, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the concession permits expire.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
